title: High Expectations, Extreme Letdown
text: In concept this sounds wonderful, however in execution this box is not very great. Items which were supposed to be included in the box were replaced which would be fine and understandable if they had actually replaced it with something similar, but instead replaced it with items much less in value and not even of similar use and that seem of poor quality. In addition many items are not useful or do not make much sense in this type of box, like SALT/PEPPER shakers or $2 sanitizing wipes? How does that fit a theme of "Renew"? Also there was a microneedling derma roller which can actually damage skin, is painful to use and is not at all something I would think of in terms of being therapeutic, bringing happiness or relaxation to anyones life, so that will not be used either. It does not seem like many good thoughts or considerations went into curating this box. Unfortunately this box is just not what I had hoped and expected of a "Therabox" so most likely will not be continuing with a subscription in the future.
label: negative
